def forward(self, L_x_ : torch.Tensor):
    l_x_ = L_x_
    arange = torch.arange(4097)
    getitem = arange[(None, slice(None, None, None))];  arange = None
    arange_1 = torch.arange(1024)
    getitem_1 = arange_1[(slice(None, None, None), None)];  arange_1 = None
    mod = getitem_1 % 4097;  getitem_1 = None
    mask = getitem <= mod;  getitem = mod = None
    where = torch.where(mask, l_x_, -1e+30);  mask = l_x_ = None
    softmax = torch.softmax(where, dim = -1);  where = None
    return (softmax,)
